EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – D Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1003

The EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – D Eco-Friendly Gift Set (D1003) is one of the most thoughtfully curated sustainable gift hampers designed for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, festive gifting, and eco-conscious celebrations. Every item inside this eco gift box promotes sustainability, making it a meaningful choice for organisations looking to reduce their carbon footprint. With premium-quality plantable stationery, cork accessories, and biodegradable products, this eco gift set is ideal for brands committed to green initiatives.

This beautifully crafted eco-friendly gift set features a Plantable Diary A5 Hard, a Mini Plantable Calendar (MDF), and a Mini Grow Kit that encourages recipients to plant and nurture seeds—symbolizing growth, positivity, and environmental awareness. The addition of cork sticky notes and a set of 4 cork coasters with holder adds practicality while maintaining the sustainability theme. The plantable pen and pencil set (2+2) is a standout eco-friendly stationery choice that decomposes easily and grows into plants after use. Everything is elegantly packed in a premium rigid box (8”x8”x3”), making the gift set ready for corporate events, festive occasions, or employee onboarding.

Designed with high-demand eco-friendly corporate gifts keywords and environmentally responsible materials, this sustainable gift box delivers value, functionality, and an impressive unboxing experience. Brands looking for high-impact, eco-positive gifting will find this collection ideal for reducing waste and encouraging green habits in workplaces. Every component supports eco-conscious living while offering long-term usability.

Key Features of the Everyday Eco Gift Box – D Eco-Friendly Gift Set (D1003)

  • Plantable Diary A5 Hard: Made using high-quality plantable seed paper that grows into herbs or flowers after use. A durable, eco-friendly diary perfect for daily notes, meetings, and planning.
  • Mini Plantable Calendar (MDF): A reusable desk calendar with plantable seed cards, combining functional design with environmental impact.
  • Mini Grow Kit (2” Pot + Peat): Includes a biodegradable pot, peat mix, and seeds—ideal for beginners and nature lovers.
  • Cork Sticky Note: Reusable cork-based memo pad, replacing paper waste with a natural, biodegradable alternative.
  • 4 Cork Coasters with Holder: Anti-slip, heat-resistant cork coasters suitable for home or office use. Comes with an elegant cork holder.
  • Plantable Pen Pencil Set (2+2): Eco-friendly writing tools made from recycled paper embedded with seeds. Write, plant, and watch them grow.
  • Premium Rigid Box (8”x8”x3”): A sturdy and elegant gift box ideal for premium corporate gifting and festive occasions.

Whether you’re a brand aiming to adopt sustainable corporate gifting or an individual looking for meaningful, eco-conscious presents, the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – D Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1003 checks every box. With plantable, reusable, and biodegradable items, it’s a perfect blend of style, sustainability, and utility. This green gift box helps create a positive environmental impact and leaves a lasting impression on anyone who receives it.
